_comment: REFERENCE TEMPLATE — copy into the theme as templates/page.loyalty.json,
then pick 'loyalty' as the template when creating the Rewards page.
The app block is NOT pre-wired here, deliberately. In a template JSON an
per-app and per-environment, so a hardcoded one would silently fail to
render on any other install. Add it in the theme editor instead: open the
'Apps' section below and click Add block -> Loyalty & Rewards. One click,
and it then persists in the merchant's own template.
Section types below are Dawn's. Settings are left at their defaults on
purpose — setting keys differ between theme versions, and a wrong key is a
broken template. The merchant fills in copy in the editor.
Order is the recommendation, not a requirement: lead with the widget so a
returning customer sees their balance without scrolling, and put the
explanatory content below it for the people who need it.
